faq.a: A 7-day confirmation, a 48-hour reminder, and a same-day reminder, each asking for a YES or NO reply.
A YES reply holds the slot. A NO reply starts rescheduling and opens the slot for the waitlist the same day.
faq.q: What happens when a patient replies NO?

how_to_use: Read the guide in order. Collect a 2-week baseline in the appointment log. Load the 3 message scripts into your reminder system. Pilot the sequence with one provider, add the waitlist routine, then expand. Review reason codes monthly and adjust send times.
limitations: This kit covers administrative reminders and scheduling workflow only. It does not address clinical care, staffing levels, payer policies, or software selection. It contains no patient data and no clinical guidance. Illustrative examples use invented numbers clearly labeled illustrative; the only real figures cited are the 15-20 percent no-show range and about 60 percent reach for single day-before calls stated in the product brief.
long_description: A front-desk kit for dental and medical outpatient practices that want a steadier appointment book. It provides message templates for all 3 touches (7-day confirmation, 48-hour reminder, same-day reminder) with YES/NO replies, a confirmation-flow SOP, a waitlist backfill log, a reason-coded no-show tracker with formulas, and a 90-day rollout plan. The workbook tracks appointments, message performance, waitlist fills, reason-code shares, and rollout progress. All examples are labeled illustrative and the kit makes no clinical claims.
name: Clinic No-Show Reduction Kit
outcome_statement: Run a documented 3-touch confirmation routine with waitlist backfill and reason-coded tracking, so open slots are refilled faster and scheduling patterns become visible in your own numbers.
problem_statement: No-show rates of 15-20 percent mean permanently lost chair and room time that cannot be recovered later. Single day-before calls reach about 60 percent of patients, leaving the rest unconfirmed until it is too late to refill the slot.
short_description: A 3-touch reminder and waitlist kit that helps dental and medical practices confirm more visits and refill open slots faster.
support: Email support for file-access and how-to-use questions. For reminder-system setup or patient-communication policy questions, consult your own software vendor and office policies.
whats_included: Workbook with 5 sheets: appointment and no-show log with rate formulas, message-performance tracker, waitlist log, reason-code summary, rollout checklist
5 document templates: 7-day confirmation script, 48-hour reminder script, same-day reminder script, cancellation and reschedule reply template, staff SOP one-pager
90-day rollout plan with phases and weekly actions
